---
title: "Differential_Abundance_with_ANCOM-BC"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

# Loading in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# Reading in phyloseq object from alpha diversity analysis
ps = readRDS('phyloseq_taxonomy.rds')

# Reading in taxonomy table
taxonomy_df <- read_tsv("taxonomy.tsv")

# Agglomerating ASVs to genus level 
ps_genus = tax_glom(ps, "Genus")

# ANCOMBC2 analysis at the genus level
set.seed(421)
out = ancombc2(data = ps_genus, 
               fix_formula = 'Lived_on_farm', 
               p_adj_method = 'BH',
               prv_cut = 0.05)

statistical_table = out$res


taxa_to_plot = statistical_table %>%
  filter(diff_robust_Lived_on_farmYes)

# Plotting bar chart of log fold-change values for significant taxa identified
taxa_to_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = lfc_Lived_on_farmYes)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip()

# Tidying the taxonomy table 
taxonomy_df <- taxonomy_df %>%
  rename(taxon = `Feature ID`) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = str_split(Taxon, ";"),
    Genus = sapply(Genus, function(x) {
      x <- trimws(x)
      genus_hit <- x[str_detect(x, "D_5__|g__")]
      if (length(genus_hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      genus_hit[1]
    }),
    Genus = str_remove(Genus, "D_5__|g__"),
    Genus = na_if(Genus, ""),
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unclassified", Genus)
  ) %>%
  select(taxon, Genus)

# Selecting taxa to plot - top 10 taxa with the lowest p-value (first 10 rows of arranged taxonomy data frame)
taxa_to_plot <- statistical_table %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_df, by = "taxon") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(lfc_Lived_on_farmYes))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unclassified", Genus),
    Genus_label = make.unique(Genus),
    Direction = ifelse(lfc_Lived_on_farmYes > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    Genus_label = fct_reorder(Genus_label, lfc_Lived_on_farmYes)
  )

# Plotting top 10 taxa by effect size
p <- ggplot(taxa_to_plot, aes(x = Genus_label, y = lfc_Lived_on_farmYes, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("Positive" = "#4C72B0", "Negative" = "#DD8452"),
  labels = c("Positive" = "Enriched in Farm",
             "Negative" = "Enriched in Non-Farm"),
  name = "Group"
) +
  labs(
    x = "Genus",
    y = "Log2 Fold Change",
    fill = "Fold change"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = c(min(taxa_to_plot$lfc_Lived_on_farmYes) - 1,
                      max(taxa_to_plot$lfc_Lived_on_farmYes) + 1)) 
p

```
